replication.target_description: Section 5.2, page 9: percentage of engaged behavior during regular classroom reading instruction, baseline versus intervention, randomized multiple-baseline study across four students.

es.metric: average bias-corrected standardized mean difference g (Busk and Serlin no-assumptions d, small-baseline-observation correction)
es.location: p. 9, section 5.2; metric definition p. 8, section 4.5
es.quote:
The apparent increase in the percentage of engaged behavior from an average of 59% engagement during baseline to 74% during
intervention (average g = 1.41; average NAP = 0.67) was not statistically significant (p = .29)

notes: Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. No original primary source was assigned or consulted. Page 9 uniquely reports the engaged-behavior baseline-versus-intervention comparison compatible with the phase contrast in the description: average g = 1.41, same-test p = .29 (exact). Follow-up engagement g = 1.25 is a different contrast and was not selected. The reading continuation on page 9 concerns baseline versus follow-up. Only es_value_r is assigned. The metric is defined in section 4.5 as Busk and Serlin no-assumptions standardized mean difference d and its bias-corrected g, not relabeled or converted.
